reads.note: Ivanhoe runs down the plate's left edge. Its west line (x~672) is the plate boundary and continues as Montgomery's west edge south of the junction (corner ~672,5318). Its east lot line is x~727. Montgomery's east lot line is ~785 at y=5300 and the road is ~105 px wide horizontally, with tracks at ~720-735. Ivanhoe enters at an acute angle; its centreline (x~700) meets Montgomery's centreline at ~y 5362. Hudson Avenue meets Montgomery from the other side at ~(800,5195), and Wayland at ~(1010,4760).

Ivanhoe runs N-S along the left map edge (map edge x~670, east line x~727; may be partly cut by the plate edge) and ends at diagonal Montgomery Road (street lines incl. orange/yellow strips, ~60-70 ft, centre slope dx/dy~-0.56). Point = Ivanhoe centre (~x 700) on Montgomery centreline. Nothing mapped west/south (white).
